description: CLI and daemon of BrowserSkill, which lets AI agents use your real, logged-in Chrome or Edge browser
notes: bsk is only the CLI and daemon. Install the BrowserSkill extension (Chrome / Edge) and the agent skill separately, e.g. 'bsk install-skill'.

bsk updates itself by default, which would rewrite files inside the versioned Scoop app directory. To let Scoop manage the version, set the user environment variable BSK_AUTO_UPDATE=off, and upgrade with 'scoop update bsk'.
If 'bsk' resolves to another copy (for example ~\.local\bin\bsk.exe from the official installer), check 'Get-Command bsk -All'.
